# TranscribeMe

> > Professional transcription services combining AI-powered automation and human expertise for audio and video content across legal, medical, academic, and media industries.

TranscribeMe offers multiple service tiers including Machine Express (automated), First Draft, and Standard/Verbatim transcription with HIPAA compliance. The platform serves diverse clients from podcasters and students to legal professionals and religious organizations, with support for multiple languages including Spanish.
